evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reads 437.4 °C while other column temperatures are approximately 63–70 °C.
T701 remains exceptionally high at 439.5 °C, versus T702 70.3, T703 70.4, T704 70.0 and T712 63.3 °C; the persistent discrepancy requires verification.
System pressure is 500.3 mbar and pressure differences are 0.6 and 2.9 mbar, broadly stable throughout; no corresponding pressure excursion corroborates the extreme temperature.
Reflux and distillate flows are 0.1 and 0.2 L/h; reported ratio is 6.8, inconsistent with their direct ratio if FYI702 represents contemporaneous reflux/distillate flow.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature and heater status, T701 calibration and raw-signal/scaling checks, protocol temperature limits and flow setpoints, and FYI702 definition would distinguish real overheating from instrumentation or software error; composition measurements and target criteria are needed to assess separation.
